spec.aria: Block diagram: u enters a summing junction, whose output x2 prime feeds an integrator giving x2 equal to y prime, then a second integrator giving x1 equal to y. x2 is fed back through gain 3 and x1 through gain 2, both with minus signs, into the summing junction.
